title: Monolithic Frontend Bundle with Zero Route Code-Splitting
impact: All 24 pages imported statically creating a single 1.41 MB JavaScript bundle
fix: Implement React.lazy and Suspense for all page routes

title: Direct Static File Upload Serving from App Origin
impact: Uploaded resumes and avatars served directly via express.static on app origin without sandboxing
fix: Serve uploads from dedicated storage subdomain or enforce attachment Content-Disposition

title: Orphan Base tsconfig and Relaxed Strictness in Frontend
impact: Base tsconfig is unextended and frontend disables noUnusedLocals and noUnusedParameters
fix: Extend tsconfig.base.json and enforce strict TypeScript settings across all workspaces

title: Naive Prompt Context Injection Labeled as RAG Without Vector Store
impact: RAG pipeline lacks embeddings vector database chunking and reranker injecting raw MongoDB rows
fix: Document system as prompt context injection or integrate pgvector with embedding models

title: Domain Services Directly Importing Express Transport Types
impact: Services couple to Express Request/Response objects violating layer separation
fix: Decouple services from HTTP transport types by passing pure DTOs

title: Monolithic God Component Files Exceeding 1000 LOC
impact: 21 source files exceed 500 LOC with pages up to 2595 LOC mixing styles subcomponents and state
fix: Decompose large page components into modular cohesive subcomponents

title: Floating Point IEEE-754 Number Type Used for Salary Fields
impact: Salaries stored as JavaScript Number double instead of integer cents or Decimal128
fix: Store monetary values in smallest currency unit or use Decimal128

title: Absence of Deterministic Database Migrations System
impact: Codebase relies on runtime Mongoose schema initialization without migration tool
fix: Implement migrate-mongo or Umzug for deterministic database evolutions
